_description: Output field reference for message +read stdout JSON

fields.data.attachments: Array of attachment objects; no attachments is []
fields.data.attachments[].attachment_id: Attachment identifier (att_ prefix) for normal attachments; use attachment +download when present
fields.data.attachments[].download_url: Direct download URL for a large attachment when attachment_id is absent
fields.data.body_format: Message body format: HTML, MARKDOWN, or PLAIN
fields.data.from: Sender object with name and email
fields.data.from.name: Sender display name
fields.data.is_read: Whether the message has been read
fields.data.subject: Email subject
fields.data.to[].name: Recipient display name
